stories.title: Surgeon having lunch near Krakow shooting undoubtedly saved officer's life, colleague says
stories.body: Further details have emerged about two police officers hailed for preventing a Polish gunman from killing more.

stories.title: Seven dead and more than 100 injured after trains collide in Egypt
stories.body: Several carriages derailed after two trains travelling in the same direction crashed outside the city of Giza.

stories.title: Homes and temples glow across India to mark Diwali
stories.body: Millions of Indians are marking the festival of lights with glowing lamps, fireworks and traditional sweets.

stories.title: Iran executes three men for 'armed unrest' after January protests
stories.body: It is claimed Hassan Dioband, Hamid Kazemi and Reza Zanganeh were part of anti-government protests earlier this year.

stories.title: Houthis say at least 33 killed in Saudi air strike
stories.body: Saudi Arabia, which leads a coalition fighting the Houthis in Yemen, has not commented.

stories.title: 'Flat', 'tired', 'cynical': Unusually gloomy Kiwis deliver New Zealand's tightest election in years
stories.body: The national mood is low, and faith in politics even lower - with voters deserting the major parties at the polls.

stories.title: Paraguay's former president charged after bank collapse
stories.body: Santiago Peña was ousted due to a banking crisis which left millions of people unable to access their money.

stories.title: Pope in 'pretty good health' as he starts Latin America tour
stories.body: Pope Leo travels to Uruguay just three weeks after having surgery for lung cancer.

stories.title: Italian foreign minister says hackers leaked his personal data
stories.body: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has blamed pro-Russian hackers for publishing the details online.

stories.title: Russian strikes wound nine and damage Ukraine's power network ahead of talks
stories.body: The attacks come before Ukrainian and Russian delegations are due to take part in trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi next week.

stories.title: US offers $20m reward for information about Iran's nuclear programme
stories.body: Donald Trump has repeatedly raised the prospect of renewing strikes against Iran's nuclear facilities.

stories.title: Meghan's father Thomas Markle under house arrest after child sex abuse material charge
stories.body: The 82-year-old appeared in court in Florida after the FBI searched two Los Angeles-area storage units he rented.

stories.title: UK cannot 'cherry pick' EU single market deal, Barnier tells BBC
stories.body: The former Brexit negotiator says EU countries would reject any British attempts to follow economic rules "a la carte".

stories.title: Texas mayor instructs police to limit co-operation with ICE
stories.body: There has been months of public outcry in Houston after an Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) officer fatally shot a man who was driving to work.

stories.title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values
stories.body: Investors had been selling off tech shares in part due to concerns the Democrat election victory would mean slower AI development.

stories.title: New wave of bomb threats hit European airlines
stories.body: No link has been established between the threats against the airlines and those against the media outlets.

stories.title: Spain's rail authorities face European fraud probe after Urda rail disaster
stories.body: Prosecutors begin investigating EU funds meant for upgrading the Spanish railway line where a train crash killed 69 people.

stories.title: Kenyan doomsday cult leader given life sentence for murdering 191 people
stories.body: Paul Mackenzie ordered his followers to starve their children to death in a forest so they could "meet Jesus".

stories.title: Doctor who treated victims of Krakow shooting speaks to the BBC
stories.body: Two doctors were eating near the city's Main Market Square when a gunman began firing at random.

stories.title: Footage shows derailed carriages after fatal train crash in Egypt
stories.body: At least seven people died when two trains collided, causing several carriages to derail and fall down an embankment.
